comment: Great professor and puts clear effort into every single class, they are always available and willing to help. They are a tough grader, but if you put in the work you'll do just fine. This class is difficult if you're not majoring in something creative, so keep in mind this class might be more challenging than expected just for a gened credit.

I would not recommend this course I spent hours in the dark room to receive subpar grades. Given that this is an intro to photography class that everybody takes for their gen ed GM should not be grading so hard. They are also impossible to reach outside of class if you are confused.
